function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More | |-------|------------|--------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on freeways, 35 mph on expressways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.001–545.004 | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Children under 4 must be in a rear‑facing seat. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.005–545.006 | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices allowed. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.007 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for adults.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.008–545.009 | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at red lights and stop signs.
• Yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.010–545.012 | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not pass on the right unless the vehicle ahead is turning left. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.013–545.014 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Stop for all school buses with flashing red lights.
• Do not pass a stopped school bus. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.015–545.016 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or on sidewalks.
• Pay attention to posted parking signs. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.017–545.018 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Annual registration renewal required.
• Vehicle inspections required in some counties. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.019–545.020 | | **Accident Reporting** | • Report accidents involving injury, death, or property damage over $1,000 to the police. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | ### How to Get Official Text - **Texas Transportation Code**: Available online at the Texas Legislature’s website or through the Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV). - **Texas DMV**: Offers printable handbooks, FAQs, and downloadable PDFs on traffic laws. ### Quick Tips - **Always check for local ordinances**: Cities may have stricter speed limits or additional rules. - **Use the Texas DMV’s “Traffic Law” section**: It provides concise summaries and updates. - **Stay updated**: Traffic laws can change; check the DMV or Texas Legislature sites annually. If you need more detailed explanations on a specific rule or want to know how a particular law applies to a situation, let me know!
